text: Green's theorem equates the line integral of (P dx + Q dy) around a positively oriented simple closed curve C to the double integral over the enclosed region D of:
explanation: Green's theorem gives the circulation form: the line integral equals the double integral of (Q_x - P_y), the scalar curl of (P,Q). The combination (P_x + Q_y) is the divergence, which belongs to the flux (normal) form, and the sign or ordering in the other options is wrong.
